rationale: The distribution thesis is mechanically intact — price is still below the 9-EMA ($40.41), 4.6% below session VWAP, and the tape (SPY -0.69%, VIXY +2.43%, no new headlines) hasn't changed, while the two-candle bounce off the $39.90 session low has not reclaimed even the 9-EMA. The frozen stop at $40.85 remains unthreatened (MAE only -0.82%) and the $39.40 target with the unfilled gap at $38.89 offers better than 1:1 follow-through if $39.90 gives way. Flipping long against an all-day lower-high structure would need far stronger evidence than one bounce candle, and closing at the lows into that bounce surrenders a working position at the worst possible location.
